cases.question: 已完成订单一共有多少笔？
cases.business_definition: 仅统计 order_status 为 completed 的订单数量。
cases.expected_sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS completed_order_count FROM sales_orders WHERE order_status = 'completed'

cases.question: 最近三个月各月销售收入是多少？
cases.business_definition: 收入使用 net_amount，仅含已完成订单，并按订单日汇率折算人民币；最近三个月以 CURDATE 动态计算。
cases.expected_sql: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m-01') AS month, SUM(o.net_amount * r.rate_to_cny) AS revenue_cny FROM sales_orders o JOIN exchange_rates r ON o.order_date = r.rate_date AND o.currency = r.currency WHERE o.order_status = 'completed' AND o.order_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 3 MONTH) AND o.order_date < CURDATE() + INTERVAL 1 DAY GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(o.order_date, '%Y-%m-01') ORDER BY month

cases.question: 按客户类型统计已完成订单数量。
cases.business_definition: 通过 customer_id 关联客户维表，并排除取消和待处理订单。
cases.expected_sql: SELECT c.customer_type, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM sales_orders o JOIN dim_customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id WHERE o.order_status = 'completed' GROUP BY c.customer_type ORDER BY c.customer_type

cases.question: 全部已完成订单的销售额是多少人民币？
cases.business_definition: 销售额使用不含税 net_amount，仅含已完成订单，并按订单日期和币种关联汇率折算人民币。
cases.expected_sql: SELECT SUM(o.net_amount * r.rate_to_cny) AS revenue_cny FROM sales_orders o JOIN exchange_rates r ON o.order_date = r.rate_date AND o.currency = r.currency WHERE o.order_status = 'completed'

cases.question: 全部已完成订单的销售成本是多少？
cases.business_definition: 销售成本为材料成本与人工成本之和乘以已售数量，仅含已完成订单。
cases.expected_sql: SELECT SUM((p.material_cost + p.labor_cost) * o.quantity) AS sales_cost FROM sales_orders o JOIN dim_products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id WHERE o.order_status = 'completed'

cases.question: 各产品线的毛利是多少？
cases.business_definition: 毛利为人民币销售收入减销售成本，仅含已完成订单，并按产品线聚合。
cases.expected_sql: SELECT p.product_line, SUM(o.net_amount * r.rate_to_cny - (p.material_cost + p.labor_cost) * o.quantity) AS gross_profit FROM sales_orders o JOIN dim_products p ON o.product_id = p.product_id JOIN exchange_rates r ON o.order_date = r.rate_date AND o.currency = r.currency WHERE o.order_status = 'completed' GROUP BY p.product_line ORDER BY p.product_line

cases.question: 2026年第三季度的期间费用是多少？
cases.business_definition: 期间费用只汇总研发、销售、管理和财务四个总项，不重复加入销售费用子项。
cases.expected_sql: SELECT SUM(rd_expense + selling_expense + admin_expense + finance_expense) AS period_expense FROM finance_expenses WHERE expense_date >= '2026-07-01' AND expense_date < '2026-10-01'

cases.question: 按地区统计已完成订单的销售额。
cases.business_definition: 销售额使用不含税 net_amount，按汇率折算人民币，仅含已完成订单，并按地区聚合。
cases.expected_sql: SELECT o.region, SUM(o.net_amount * r.rate_to_cny) AS revenue_cny FROM sales_orders o JOIN exchange_rates r ON o.order_date = r.rate_date AND o.currency = r.currency WHERE o.order_status = 'completed' GROUP BY o.region ORDER BY o.region
